answer_1.quote: We evaluated our models on the test set of AfriQA , a cross-lingual question answering dataset with questions in 10 African languages and gold passages in English or French. We evaluated in zero-shot generative cross-lingual QA settings using in-lang queries and the provided gold passages in English.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers in cross-lingual QA, translated text in machine translation, and summaries in abstractive summarization
